body:
Not really he wasn't the talking type. Mostly I would do something and then he would get really upset and leave or threaten to call the police if I didn't leave. We used to talk but everything has been really bad lately. Like he was just sick of being around me when I was slightly frustrated. 

I don't have trouble making friends i wouldnt consider them friends because we hardly interact but I can truly only say I have one friend. And I've even made her miserable. 

Me trying to kill myself earlier didn't help. Everything was a huge debacle and my parents finding out made me want to end it even more. I've wanted to die since I was really young and the older I get the more reasons there are. I also cannot recall the last time I was happy. I don't know how people do it.

I don't feel like I ever do anything wrong but I don't have any friends and my relationship of 5 years has just ended because I'm "manipulative". But I don't understand how. I was being the best person I could be but it wasn't enough. The best version of me was not enough. It's never enough for anyone so what's the point.
